articles.title: Four Malicious npm Packages Deliver Infostealers and Phantom Bot DDoS Malware
articles.summary: A researcher just dropped a Windows privilege escalation zero-day called MiniPlasma that grants SYSTEM access on fully patched systems. Because apparently Microsoft's patch cycle is more like patch suggestions.

articles.title: Pwn2Own Berlin 2026, Day Three: DEVCORE Crowned Master of Pwn, $1.298 Million Total
articles.summary: Microsoft Exchange Server zero-day is being actively exploited via crafted emails with no permanent patch for on-prem deployments. Classic Microsoft: break first, maybe fix later.

articles.title: U.S. CISA adds a flaw in Microsoft Exchange Server to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog
articles.summary: Pwn2Own Berlin 2026 ended with 47 zero-days discovered and $1.29M in payouts, proving once again that ethical hackers are doing the lord's work. DEVCORE absolutely demolished the competition.

articles.title: Anti-DDoS Firm Heaped Attacks on Brazilian ISPs
articles.summary: Canvas got pwned by cybercriminals who defaced the login page with ransom demands, disrupting education nationwide. Nothing says 'back to school' like a good old-fashioned extortion attack.

articles.title: NGINX Rift attackers waste no time targeting exposed servers
articles.summary: The Shai-Hulud worm exploited GitHub Actions misconfiguration to poison TanStack's shared cache in a supply chain attack. Now they're considering invitation-only PRs because trust is dead.

articles.title: Victory! End-to-End Encrypted RCS Comes to Apple and Android Chats
articles.summary: Instagram killed its end-to-end encryption feature after years of promising privacy by default across Meta platforms. Broken promises from Big Tech, shocking absolutely no one.

articles.title: EFF Launches New Offline Campaign for Saudi Wikipedian Osama Khalid
articles.summary: Apple finally delivered end-to-end encryption for RCS in iOS 26.5, meaning Android-iPhone chats will actually be private. Only took them forever, but better late than never.

articles.title: F-35 software delays leave UK buying time with US glide bombs
articles.summary: Poland is ditching Signal for a state-developed 'secure' alternative amid social engineering attacks on government officials. Because nothing says security like homegrown government crypto.

articles.title: How to Reduce Phishing Exposure Before It Turns into Business Disruption
articles.summary: Mozilla is telling the UK that breaking VPNs won't magically solve age verification problems. Firefox makers patiently explaining that VPNs are basic security infrastructure, not teenage contraband.

articles.title: Patch Tuesday, April 2026 Edition
articles.summary: Scattered Spider member 'Tylerb' pleaded guilty to wire fraud and identity theft for SMS phishing attacks in 2022. Another cybercrime legend faces the music for their text-message social engineering spree.
